item.title: Fatal error after updating to 2.4.0
item.dc:creator: sample-user-01
item.description:
Replies: 0

After updating to 2.4.0 the dashboard shows “There has been a critical error on this website.” The debug log says:

PHP Fatal error:  Uncaught TypeError: count(): Argument #1 ($value) must be of type Countable|array, null given in /wp-content/plugins/tidy-backups-demo/includes/class-schedule.php:88

Going back to 2.3.2 fixes it. WordPress 6.9, PHP 8.3.
